arxiv-1805-08412.title: On the stochastic nonlinear Schrödinger equations with non-smooth additive noise
arxiv-1805-08412.creator: Tadahiro Oh, Oana Pocovnicu, and Yuzhao Wang
arxiv-1805-08412.description: Abstract . We study the stochastic nonlinear Schrödinger equations with additive stochastic forcing. By using the dispersive estimate, we present a simple argument, constructing a unique local-in-time solution with rougher stochastic forcing than those considered in the literature. 2010 Mathematics Subject Classification 35Q55, 60H30 1. Introduction 1.1.

arxiv-2102-09179.title: Optical design of a multi-object fiber-fed spectrograph system for Southern Spectroscopic Survey Telescope
arxiv-2102-09179.creator: YueFan Shan, ZhengBo Zhu, Hao Tan, Donglin Ma
arxiv-2102-09179.description: Abstract Southern Spectroscopic Survey Telescope (SSST) is a wide-field spectroscopic survey telescope that China plans to build in Chile in the next few years. As an instrument for astronomical spectroscopic survey, the multi-object and fiber-fed spectrograph (MOFFS) is one of the most important scientific instruments for SSST.

arxiv-2303-16873.title: Channel Phase Processing in Wireless Networks for Human Activity Recognition
arxiv-2303-16873.creator: Guillermo Diaz, Iker Sobron, Iñaki Eizmendi, Iratxe Landa, Johana Coyote, Manuel Velez
arxiv-2303-16873.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Guillermo Diaz, Iker Sobron, Iñaki Eizmendi, Iratxe Landa, Johana Coyote, Manuel Velez. The phase of the channel state information (CSI) is underutilized as a source of information in wireless sensing due to its sensitivity to synchronization errors of the signal reception. A linear transformation of the phase is commonly applied to correct linear offsets and, in a few cases, some filtering in time or frequency is carried out to smooth the data.

arxiv-2405-17585.title: Cyclic Quantum Teleportation of Two-Qubit Entangled States by using Six-Qubit Cluster State and Six-Qubit Entangled State
arxiv-2405-17585.creator: A. Slaoui, M. El Kirdi, R. Ahl Laamara, M. Alabdulhafith, S. A. Chelloug, A. A. Abd El-Latif
arxiv-2405-17585.description: Abstract Résumé Cyclic quantum teleportation schemes requires at least the existence of three collaborators acting all as senders and receivers of quantum information, each one of them has an information to be transmitted to the next neighbour in a circular manner.

arxiv-2502-19772.title: Machine-Learning Force Fields Reveal Shallow Electronic States on Dynamic Halide Perovskite Surfaces
arxiv-2502-19772.creator: Frederico P. Delgado 1, Frederico Simões 1, Leeor Kronik 2, Waldemar Kaiser 1, David A. Egger 1,3,4
arxiv-2502-19772.description: Abstract The spectacular performance of halide perovskites in optoelectronic devices is rooted in their tolerance to defects. Previous studies showed that defects in these materials generate shallow electronic states. However, how these shallow states persist amid the pronounced atomic dynamics on halide perovskite surfaces remains unknown.

arxiv-2507-13414.title: Gauge Flow Models
arxiv-2507-13414.creator: Alexander Strunk, Roland Assam
arxiv-2507-13414.description: Abstract This paper introduces Gauge Flow Models, a novel class of Generative Flow Models. These models incorporate a learnable Gauge Field within the Flow Ordinary Differential Equation (ODE). A comprehensive mathematical framework for these models, detailing their construction and properties, is provided.

arxiv-2509-12837.title: Benchmarking thermostat algorithms in molecular dynamics simulations of a binary Lennard-Jones glass-former model
arxiv-2509-12837.creator: Kumpei Shiraishi, Emi Minamitani, Kang Kim
arxiv-2509-12837.description: Abstract A systematic comparison was carried out to assess the influence of representative thermostat methods in constant-temperature molecular dynamics simulations. The thermostat schemes considered include the Nosé–Hoover thermostat and its chain generalisation, the Bussi velocity rescaling method, and several implementations of the Langevin dynamics.

pmc-11337775.title: Polypharmacy and potentially inappropriate medications in older adults who use long-term care services: a cross-sectional study
pmc-11337775.creator: Shotaro Hagiwara, Jun Komiyama, Masao Iwagami, Shota Hamada, Masato Komuro, Hiroyuki Kobayashi, Nanako Tamiya
pmc-11337775.description: BackgroundOlder adults requiring care often have multiple morbidities that lead to polypharmacy, including the use of potentially inappropriate medications (PIMs), leading to increased medical costs and adverse drug effects. We conducted a cross-sectional study to clarify the actual state of drug prescriptions and the background of polypharmacy and PIMs.

pmc-11433125.title: Central Role of the Actomyosin Ring in Coordinating Cytokinesis Steps in Budding Yeast
pmc-11433125.creator: Magdalena Foltman, Alberto Sanchez-Diaz, Jian-Qiu Wu, Erfei Bi
pmc-11433125.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Eukaryotic cells must accurately transfer their genetic material and cellular components to their daughter cells. Initially, cells duplicate their chromosomes and subsequently segregate them toward the poles. The actomyosin ring, a crucial molecular machinery normally located in the middle of the cells and underneath the plasma membrane, then physically divides the cytoplasm and all components into two daughter cells, each ready to start a new cell cycle. This process, known as cytokinesis, is conserved throughout evolution.

pmc-13306751.title: Latent Salinity Stress Detection in Opuntia ficus-indica Using Hyperspectral Imaging and a 3D-CNN Framework
pmc-13306751.creator: Juan Arredondo-Valdez, Horacio Abdiel Rodríguez-Garza, Héctor Flores-Breceda, Zayd Eliud Rangel-Nava, Néstor Everardo Aranda-Ledesma, Jesús Rodolfo Valenzuela-García, Moisés Hinojosa-Rivera, Ajay Kumar, Urbano Luna-Maldonado, Alejandro Isabel Luna-Maldonado
pmc-13306751.description: Salinity stress remains a major bottleneck for agriculture in arid regions. While Opuntia ficus-indica is known for its resilience, its young cladodes maintain a misleadingly healthy visual appearance and stable biomass even under heavy saline pressure, making traditional vegetation indices and standard statistics unreliable for early diagnosis.
